usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog and LinkedIn is where you tell people about it. “New Product” in Shopify can run “Create Image Post”, so a launch becomes a post on your profile.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Image Post” in LinkedIn
bestTemplate.why: A new product is the one Shopify event worth announcing, and the action publishes text with an image, which suits a product photo.

watchOut: “Create Image Post” publishes to your own profile, so every new product becomes a public post. Connect it to a profile you mean to post from and review the text.
